function.name: get_claim_status
function.description: Read every claim on the verified caller's account. Call it when a verified caller asks about their claims. Takes no input: the account comes from the verified call, never from the caller. Its result is a sentence that has already been spoken to the caller.

messages.content: Still pulling that up, thanks for waiting.
I'm having trouble pulling up your claims right now. I can have a representative call you back, or you can try again in a few minutes. Which would you prefer?
